purpose: A grouped ICLR review panel with optional domain-specialist routing.

iclr_reviewer_orchestrator.description: Routes the panel, preserves independent reviews, and produces the final evidence-grounded report.
iclr_reviewer_orchestrator.description_zh: 路由审稿组、保持独立评审，并生成基于证据的最终报告。

best_justified.description: Builds the strongest manuscript-supported case for acceptance.
best_justified.description_zh: 基于稿件证据构建最充分的接收理由。

critical.description: Finds the most consequential unresolved failure mode.
critical.description_zh: 寻找影响最大的未解决失败模式。

method_soundness.description: Checks formulation, assumptions, derivations, algorithms, and leakage.
method_soundness.description_zh: 检查问题定义、假设、推导、算法和数据泄漏。

evidence_experiment.description: Audits baselines, controls, metrics, ablations, statistics, and robustness.
evidence_experiment.description_zh: 审查基线、控制实验、指标、消融、统计和鲁棒性。

novelty_positioning.description: Tests the claimed contribution against the closest related work.
novelty_positioning.description_zh: 根据最接近的相关工作检验真实贡献。

writing_clarity.description: Checks definitions, logical flow, figures, tables, and readability.
writing_clarity.description_zh: 检查定义、逻辑结构、图表和可读性。

ethics_reproducibility.description: Checks harms, data rights, privacy, misuse, limitations, and reproducibility.
ethics_reproducibility.description_zh: 检查潜在伤害、数据权利、隐私、滥用、局限和复现性。

domain_application.description: Validates domain assumptions, utility, and evaluation realism.
domain_application.description_zh: 验证领域假设、实际效用和评测真实性。

evidence_ablation.description: Tests whether evidence isolates the contribution of each component.
evidence_ablation.description_zh: 检验实验是否隔离了各组件的真实贡献。

reproducibility.description: Reconstructs the implementation and experimental protocol from the paper.
reproducibility.description_zh: 根据论文重建实现细节和实验流程。

novice_advocate.display_name_zh: 非专家可理解性审稿人
novice_advocate.description: Identifies unexplained prerequisites and inaccessible presentation.
novice_advocate.description_zh: 识别未解释的前置知识和难以理解的表达。

ac_meta_reviewer.description: Resolves reviewer disagreements from evidence without averaging away blockers.
ac_meta_reviewer.description_zh: 根据证据解决评审冲突，不用平均分掩盖致命问题。

citation_auditor.description: Independently checks citation existence and claim support when sources are available.
citation_auditor.description_zh: 在来源可用时独立核验引用存在性和论断支持关系。
